international.title: Breakaway group of 110 clubs deliberately misses Football Queensland registration as revolt over $5 gate fees builds
international.summary: Clubs fail to sign up for 2027 season as disquiet over governing body’s executive grips football community About 100 football clubs, representing hundreds of thousands of players, have deliberately missed the deadline to sign up for next season amid a dispute with Football Queensland. The disagreement has forced Football Australia to intervene, after a breakaway group threatened earlier this week to form its own competition. Continue reading...
